StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
Navigate to Patients tab
Wait for Patients tab to load
Generate random surname for new patient
Enter random surname in patient search
Click Find to search for patient
Wait for patient search results
Click Book Registration link to open registration form
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient Forename
Enter patient Surname (random value)
Enter Postal Code
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Wait for address lookup results
Select address row from lookup results
Enter City
Select Country
Enter Home Telephone number
Enter Mobile Telephone number
Enter Email address
Click Next to proceed to demographics section
Wait for demographics section to load
Select Communication Preference Type
Select Country of Birth
Select Nationality
Select Religion
Select Sexual Orientation
Select Ethnicity
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup
Capture and store NHS Number allocated to patient
Verify NHS Number is not empty
Click OK to dismiss registration confirmation popup
Wait for home page after registration
Click Find Record to search for registered patient
Wait for patient basic search form
Enter random surname to find registered patient
Click Find to search for patient
Wait for patient search results
Click patient surname link to open EPR
Wait for EPR view to load
Verify EPR loaded - PASID field is visible
Store PAS ID from EPR for later reference
Click Referrals tab to navigate to referral section
Wait for Referrals tab to load
Click Create Referral link
Wait for Create Referral form to load
Select Service Type for the referral
Select Referral Source
Select Referral Priority
Select Referral Type
Click Finish Now to submit the referral
Wait for referral creation to complete
Verify referral row is displayed in referral list
-- ADMIT PATIENT --
Select referral row in list to initiate admit
Click Inpatient option from context menu to initiate admission
Wait for Admission road map page to load
Select Admission Source
Select Admission Type
Select Intended Management
Select Ward Name for admission
Click Next to proceed to admission confirmation
Wait for admission confirmation page
Click Finish to complete patient admission
Wait for EPR to load after admission
Verify EPR loaded after admission
-- NAVIGATE TO STRUCTURED CARE EPR VIEW --
Click Care Plan tab in Structured EPR View
Wait for Care Plan section to load in EPR
Verify Care Plan tab is active in EPR
-- CREATE CARE PLAN --
Click Create Care Plan link from context menu
Wait for template search page to load
Enter Care Plan template name to search
Click Find to search for care plan template
Wait for template search results
Click Next to proceed with selected template
Wait for care plan details page
Click Define Care Plan Content link
Wait for Define Care Plan Content page
Select need row from care plan content list
Click Finish Now to save care plan content
Wait for care plan creation to complete
-- VALIDATE CREATED CARE PLAN --
Verify care plan list is displayed after creation
Verify Create Care Plan link is available confirming save
-- MODIFY CARE PLAN --
Select the created care plan row from the list
Click Modify Care Plan link from context menu
Wait for Care Plan Details page to load
Select Reason for Modification
Wait for Modify Care Plan page to load
Click Define Care Plan Content link to modify content
Wait for Define Care Plan Content page
Expand need row to review content
Click Finish Now to save modified care plan content
Wait for care plan modification to complete
-- VALIDATE MODIFIED CARE PLAN --
Verify care plan row is displayed after modification
Verify Modify Care Plan link is available confirming update saved
-- COPY CARE PLAN --
Select the created care plan row to copy
Click Copy Care Plan link from context menu
Wait for Care Plan Details page for copy
Enter unique name for the copied care plan
Wait for Copy Care Plan page to load
Click Define Care Plan Content link for copied plan
Wait for Define Care Plan Content page
Click Finish Now to save copied care plan content
Wait for care plan copy to complete
-- VALIDATE COPIED CARE PLAN --
Verify copied care plan row is displayed in the list
Verify Copy Care Plan link is available confirming copy saved
-- MANAGE STATUS: SUSPENDED --
Select the copied care plan row to manage status
Click Manage Status link from context menu
Wait for Manage Care Plan Status page to load
Select new status as Suspended
Wait for Manage Status LORENZO page
Click Finish to save Suspended status
Wait for care plan list to reload after status change
-- VALIDATE CARE PLAN STATUS: SUSPENDED --
Verify care plan row is displayed with Suspended status
Verify Manage Status link confirms status action is available
-- MANAGE STATUS: CLOSED --
Select the copied care plan row for Closed status
Click Manage Status link from context menu
Wait for Manage Care Plan Status page to load
Select new status as Closed
Wait for Manage Status LORENZO page
Click Finish to save Closed status
Wait for care plan list to reload after Closed status change
-- VALIDATE CARE PLAN STATUS: CLOSED --
Verify care plan row is displayed with Closed status
Verify Manage Status link confirms Closed status saved
-- MANAGE STATUS: STRIKEOUT --
Select the copied care plan row for Strikeout status
Click Manage Status link from context menu
Wait for Manage Care Plan Status page to load
Select new status as Strikeout
Wait for Manage Status LORENZO page
Click Finish to save Strikeout status
Wait for care plan list to reload after Strikeout status change
-- VALIDATE CARE PLAN STATUS: STRIKEOUT --
Verify care plan row is displayed with Strikeout status
Verify Manage Status link confirms Strikeout action completed
Logout of Lorenzo application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes
Wait for logout to complete
